title: Importing Multi-Tab Excel Files into Business Central
summary: This post explains how to import multi-tab Excel files into Business Central with a header/line relationship structure. It provides code examples using AL to read separate header and line sheets, maintain relational integrity with a dictionary-based key mapping system, and populate staging tables.
key_points: Use Excel's sheet-specific tab reading to separate header and line data while maintaining relationships
Store mapping keys in a Dictionary to connect header records with their corresponding line items without excessive lookups
Read each sheet independently using TempExcelBuffer.OpenBookStream() with the sheet name parameter
Process headers first, then lines, using the stored keys to establish parent-child relationships
features: Excel file import with multiple sheets

quotes.text: With Header/Line, or any other relational data, we have the challenge of relationship management.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the core problem that multi-tab Excel imports must solve when dealing with related data structures
